mapper.update: UPDATE `goal` SET object_name = #{objectName}, target_amount = #{targetAmount}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, isa_rate = #{isaRate}, deposit_rate = #{depositRate}, start_amount = #{startAmount}, goal_rate = #{goalRate} WHERE object_id = #{objectId} AND member_id = #{memberId} /*goal.getGoaldID*/
mapper.select: SELECT object_id, member_id, object_name, target_amount, start_date, end_date, deposit_rate, isa_rate, start_amount, goal_rate FROM `goal` WHERE object_id = #{objectId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT object_id, member_id, object_name, target_amount, start_date, end_date, deposit_rate, isa_rate, start_amount, goal_rate FROM `goal` WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY object_id DESC
mapper.delete: delete from `goal` where object_id = #{objectId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT mp.member_product_id AS memberProductId, mp.item_name AS itemName, mp.present_amount AS presentAmount, mp.quantity AS quantity, 1 AS checked FROM action a JOIN member_product mp ON mp.member_product_id = a.member_product_id WHERE a.goal_id = #{goalId} AND mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.account_type = 'ISA' AND (a.is_deleted IS NULL OR a.is_deleted = false) ORDER BY mp.member_product_id DESC

SELECT mp.member_product_id AS memberAccountId, mp.item_name AS accountName, mp.item_code AS accountNumber, mp.present_amount AS presentAmount, a.amount AS allocatedAmount, -- action 테이블에 기록된 '할당 금액' 1 AS checked -- 이미 할당된 상태이므로 checked는 true FROM action a JOIN member_product mp ON mp.member_product_id = a.member_product_id WHERE a.goal_id = #{goalId} AND mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.account_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND (a.is_deleted IS NULL OR a.is_deleted = false) ORDER BY mp.member_product_id DESC
